set.context: Common industry target (not an HFMA-published benchmark); MAP Key definitions standardize the calculation

edits.claim: fallback stat: Days in AR <40 = top quartile, HFMA MAP Keys 2023 benchmark
edits.src: HFMA MAP Keys page (fetched 2026-10-09): 29 keys in 5 groups define calculations only; HFMA publishes no public top-quartile thresholds or medians (no "MAP Keys 2023 benchmark" of <40 days, >97% NCR / ~94% median, <2% cost to collect / ~3.5% median). Kept as labelled industry rules of thumb, consistent with the ar-management and rcm-kpis decisions
